A kind of fallacious inference to be refuted by reference
 to the real sense of a word used metaphorically, {%<ab>e. g.</ab>%} if any one
 from the sentence {#maYcAH koSanti#} were to conclude that the {#maYca#}
 (platform) really cries and not persons on the platform. Nyāyadarśana.

A courteous or polite word, a mere compliment. {#upacArapadaM#}
 {#na cedidaM tvamanaNgaH kaTamakzatA ratiH .#} <ls>Ku. 4. 9</ls>.
